newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gle des Eaux up after telecoms news.
newsitem.headline: Gle des Eaux up after telecoms news.

text.p: Shares in Cie Generale des Eaux rose on Wednesday after the group announced its strategic partners in its Cegetel telecommunications unit.
The stock was 17 francs, or 3.18 percent, higher at 12.49 GMT with more than 225,000 shares tradeds, after a high of 564 francs.

Chairman Jean-Marie Messier of the French water and services group said Generale des Eaux will hold 50 percent of Cegetel directly and indirectly, British Telecommunications Plc will have 25 percent, while U.S. telecoms group SBC will have 15 percent and German Mannesmann 10 percent.
